system.description:
While your Rage is active, allies in Burst 4 gain advantage on STR saves and saves against Frightened and Taunted.

Additionally, when you Rage, you can expend 1 Fury die and choose one verse below. Effects last until the start of your next turn and affect all allies in Burst 4 that start their turn in the area or enter it on their turn:

  • Verse of Violence. Allies next attack, spell or ability gains a bonus to damage, healing or temp HP applied equal to the expended die's roll.
  • Verse of Pride. Allies gain bonus Armor, 1 round, equal to the expended die's roll.
  • Verse of Survival. Allies gain temp HP equal to half the expended die's roll.

[A] When you Rage, pick a verse (a dialog, or a card button when the Rage was free on the GM’s turn): the Fury Die you expend leaves your pool, with an Undo card. Allies in Burst 4 get the verse at once, and allies who start their turn in Burst 4 get it then; it all ends at the start of your next turn.

[A] Verse of Violence: the ally’s next damage, healing or temp HP roll gets +the die (spent by that roll). Verse of Pride: +the die Armor. Verse of Survival: temp HP equal to half the die.

[A] While you Rage, allies in Burst 4 roll STR saves with advantage (added to their save roll).

[M] Advantage on saves against Frightened and Taunted: add it in the save dialog. An ally who enters the area during their turn: give them the verse by hand. Verse of Pride on a monster ally (its armor is a category): by hand.
